recipes.title: Cheddar Cheeseburger
recipes.summary: A seared beef patty under melted cheddar, with crisp lettuce and tomato on a toasted bun.

steps.title: Prepare the patties
steps.body: Divide the ground beef into four even portions and gently shape into patties slightly wider than your buns. Season both sides generously with salt.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.body: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the patties for about three minutes per side, laying a slice of cheddar over each one for the final minute so it melts.

steps.title: Toast the buns
steps.body: While the patties rest, toast the buns cut-side down in the same skillet until golden, soaking up the pan's flavor.

steps.title: Build and serve
steps.body: Layer lettuce and tomato on each bottom bun, add the cheesy patty, crown with the top bun, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chopped Cheese
recipes.summary: The bodega classic — beef chopped into molten cheese, piled high on a soft roll.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Crumble the ground beef into a hot skillet, season with salt, and cook until deeply browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.

steps.title: Chop and melt
steps.body: Lay cheese over the beef and chop everything together with your spatula until the cheese ribbons through the meat.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Pile the cheesy beef onto toasted buns and top with shredded lettuce and tomato slices before closing them up.

recipes.title: Beef Lettuce Cups
recipes.summary: Warm seasoned beef spooned into cold, crisp lettuce leaves. All the savor, none of the bread.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.body: Brown the beef with a pinch of salt until crisp at the edges, then drain any excess fat.

steps.title: Prep the cups
steps.body: Separate whole lettuce leaves and pat them dry so they hold their crunch.

steps.title: Fill and finish
steps.body: Spoon the warm beef into the leaves, scatter diced tomato over the top, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
recipes.summary: Silky strands tossed in golden garlic butter with a snowfall of parmesan.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.body: Cook the pasta in well-salted water until just shy of tender, then scoop out a mug of the starchy water before draining.

steps.title: Toast the garlic
steps.body: Melt the butter over medium-low heat and let thinly sliced garlic turn pale gold and fragrant — pull it before it browns.

steps.title: Toss and finish
steps.body: Add the pasta with a splash of its water and toss until glossy. Shower with parmesan, toss once more, and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Salmon
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned salmon in a bright lemon and garlic pan sauce. Tastes like a restaurant order.

steps.title: Season and sear
steps.body: Pat the salmon dry, season with salt, and lay it skin-side down in hot olive oil. Leave it alone until the skin releases and crisps, about four minutes.

steps.title: Flip and baste
steps.body: Turn the fillets, add the garlic, and tilt the pan to spoon the fragrant oil over the fish for another two minutes.

steps.title: Brighten and serve
steps.body: Squeeze lemon over everything, let the juice bubble into a quick sauce, and serve the salmon glossed with it.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Bowl
recipes.summary: Charred peppers and onion over rice, with seared chicken and cool avocado.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Get the rice going first so everything else lands while it steams. Salt the water like you mean it.

steps.title: Char the vegetables
steps.body: Slice the peppers and onion thick. Cook them in olive oil over high heat without stirring much — you want blistered edges, not a stew.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.body: Push the vegetables aside, season the chicken with salt, and sear until golden and cooked through. Let it rest a minute, then slice across the grain.

steps.title: Build the bowl
steps.body: Spoon rice into each bowl, pile on the peppers and chicken, and finish with diced tomato and sliced avocado.

recipes.title: Veggie Omelette
recipes.summary: Buttery folded eggs around sweet peppers, onion, and melting cheddar.

steps.title: Soften the veggies
steps.body: Melt half the butter and cook diced bell pepper and onion until sweet and just tender. Set them aside.

steps.title: Set the eggs
steps.body: Whisk the eggs until uniform, add the rest of the butter to the pan, and pour them in. Pull the edges toward the center as they set.

steps.title: Fill and fold
steps.body: Scatter the veggies and cheddar over one half, fold the other half over, and slide it out while the center is still creamy.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Day-old rice wok-tossed with chicken, egg, and soy. Clears the shelf on its way to the table.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.body: Cut the chicken into small pieces and sear in a very hot pan until golden and cooked through. Set aside.

steps.title: Scramble and fry
steps.body: Scramble the eggs in the same pan, then add the rice and onion, pressing the rice into the heat so it toasts instead of steams.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.body: Return the chicken, splash in the soy sauce, and toss everything until every grain is coated and sizzling.

recipes.title: Turkey Club Sandwich
recipes.summary: Toasted layers of turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, and tomato. Eats like a full dinner.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.body: Cook the bacon in a skillet until deeply crisp, then drain it on a paper towel while you toast the bread in the drippings.

steps.title: Stack the layers
steps.body: Spread mayonnaise on the toast and build in layers: turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato — then repeat if you're going full double-decker.

steps.title: Press and slice
steps.body: Cap the sandwich, press it gently so it holds, and slice on the diagonal. Serve with whatever crunch you've got.

recipes.title: Garlic Veggie Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Broccoli, carrot, and bell pepper flash-cooked with garlic and soy, spooned glossy and hot over fluffy rice.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Rinse the rice and get it cooking first - everything else moves fast once the pan is hot.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.body: Cut the broccoli into small florets, slice the carrot thin on an angle, and cut the bell pepper into strips. Mince the garlic.

steps.title: Stir-fry hot and fast
steps.body: Get a splash of oil shimmering in your widest pan. Carrot first for two minutes, then broccoli and pepper until bright and just tender, then the garlic for thirty seconds more.

steps.title: Glaze and serve
steps.body: Pour in the soy sauce and toss until everything is glossy. Pile it over the rice and eat it while it still crackles.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.summary: Fluffy oat-flecked pancakes sweetened by the bananas themselves. Weekend food on a weekday budget.

steps.title: Mash and mix
steps.body: Mash the bananas until almost smooth, then whisk in the eggs and milk. Stir the flour, oats and a spoonful of sugar in last, and stop the moment it comes together — lumps make better pancakes than overmixing does.

steps.title: Let the oats drink
steps.body: Rest the batter five minutes. The oats soften, the batter thickens, and the pancakes hold their height instead of spreading thin.

steps.title: Cook low and patient
steps.body: Ladle onto a buttered pan over medium-low heat. Flip when the bubbles on top stay open, about three minutes, and give the second side two more.

steps.title: Stack and serve
steps.body: Keep them in a warm oven while you work through the batter, then stack high with sliced banana over the top.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Tomorrow's breakfast, made tonight in the jar you'll eat it from. No stove, no morning decisions.

steps.title: Fill the jar
steps.body: Tip the oats into a jar and pour over enough milk to cover them by a finger's width. Spoon the yogurt on top.

steps.title: Add the good stuff
steps.body: Swirl in the peanut butter and half a sliced banana. Stir once — you want ribbons, not a uniform beige.

steps.title: Sleep on it
steps.body: Lid on, fridge overnight. The oats drink the milk and turn creamy without a single minute of cooking.

steps.title: Finish in the morning
steps.body: Top with the rest of the banana and eat it cold, straight from the jar.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito
recipes.summary: Eggs, crisp potato and melted cheddar rolled tight enough to eat one-handed.

steps.title: Crisp the potato
steps.body: Dice the potato small so it cooks fast. Fry it in a hot pan, seasoned well, until the edges are genuinely crunchy — this is the texture the whole burrito leans on.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.body: Add diced bell pepper and onion to the same pan and cook until they slump and sweeten, about four minutes.

steps.title: Scramble soft
steps.body: Push everything aside, pour in the beaten eggs, and pull them off the heat while they still look slightly underdone. They finish cooking inside the wrap.

steps.title: Roll it tight
steps.body: Warm the tortillas, pile the filling down the middle with the cheddar, fold the sides in, and roll. Sear the seam side down for thirty seconds so it stays shut.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.summary: Thick toast, smashed avocado, a jammy egg on top. The cafe order you stop paying for.

steps.title: Boil the egg
steps.body: Lower the eggs into already-boiling water for seven minutes exactly, then straight into cold water. Seven is the number for a set white and a molten yolk.

steps.title: Toast it properly
steps.body: Toast the bread darker than feels right. Soft toast under wet avocado turns to sponge.

steps.title: Smash and season
steps.body: Fork the avocado roughly against the board with a good squeeze of lemon and plenty of seasoning. Keep it chunky.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Spread thick on the toast, peel and halve the eggs over the top, and add one more squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Bacon Egg and Cheese
recipes.summary: The deli counter classic — crisp bacon, folded egg, cheddar melted into both.

steps.title: Render the bacon
steps.body: Start the bacon in a cold pan over medium heat. It renders slowly and crisps evenly instead of seizing up. Drain it and leave the fat in the pan.

steps.title: Toast in the drippings
steps.body: Butter the bread and toast it face-down in the bacon fat until golden. This is the step that separates it from a sandwich you made at home.

steps.title: Fold the eggs
steps.body: Scramble the eggs in the same pan, low and slow, then fold them into a rough square and lay the cheddar over while they are still hot enough to melt it.

steps.title: Close it up
steps.body: Bacon on the bottom, egg and cheese on top, second slice on, and cut it in half on the diagonal.

recipes.title: Sausage Potato Hash
recipes.summary: A whole breakfast in one skillet — browned sausage, crisp potato, and eggs cracked right on top.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.body: Crumble the sausage into a wide skillet and cook until deeply browned. Leave the fat behind — the potatoes are about to cook in it.

steps.title: Fry the potatoes
steps.body: Add diced potato in an even layer and then leave it alone for a full five minutes. Stirring too early is why hash goes soggy instead of crisp.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.body: Stir in the onion and bell pepper, season, and cook until everything is tender and the edges have caught some color.

steps.title: Crack and cover
steps.body: Make wells in the hash, crack an egg into each, cover the pan, and cook until the whites set but the yolks still run.

recipes.title: Spinach Mushroom Scramble
recipes.summary: Slow, creamy eggs folded around garlicky mushrooms and wilted spinach.

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.body: Cook sliced mushrooms in butter over high heat without crowding or stirring. Wait for them to release their water and then take on real color — pale mushrooms taste of nothing.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.body: Add the garlic for thirty seconds, then the spinach by the handful until it collapses. Season and tip it all onto a plate.

steps.title: Scramble low
steps.body: Melt more butter over the lowest heat your stove will hold and stir the eggs constantly. It takes several minutes and the curds stay small and glossy.

steps.title: Fold together
steps.body: Fold the mushrooms and spinach through the eggs off the heat, and serve while they are still loose.

recipes.title: French Toast
recipes.summary: Custard-soaked bread fried in butter until the edges caramelize.

steps.title: Make the custard
steps.body: Whisk the eggs, milk and a spoonful of sugar until completely uniform. Any unbeaten white shows up later as a rubbery streak.

steps.title: Soak, don't dunk
steps.body: Lay each slice in the custard for twenty seconds a side. Stale bread can take longer; fresh bread will fall apart if you push it.

steps.title: Fry in butter
steps.body: Medium-low heat and a generous knob of butter. Three minutes a side, until the sugar in the custard caramelizes into a lacquered crust.

steps.title: Serve hot
steps.body: Cut on the diagonal and eat immediately — french toast waits for nobody.

recipes.title: Tuna Melt
recipes.summary: Sharp tuna salad under bubbling cheddar on buttered, griddled bread.

steps.title: Mix the salad
steps.body: Drain the tuna properly — really press it — then fork it together with mayonnaise and finely diced onion. Season and taste.

steps.title: Build the sandwich
steps.body: Pile the tuna on one slice, cover it edge to edge with cheddar, and close with the second slice. Butter the outsides.

steps.title: Griddle low
steps.body: Cook over medium-low heat with something heavy pressed on top. Low and slow is what gets the cheese molten before the bread burns.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.body: Turn once, give it another three minutes, and cut it in half so the cheese pulls.

recipes.title: BLT Sandwich
recipes.summary: Three ingredients doing all the work: crisp bacon, cold lettuce, ripe tomato.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.body: Cook the bacon until it snaps rather than bends. A BLT lives or dies on this.

steps.title: Toast and dress
steps.body: Toast the bread and spread mayonnaise right to the edges on both slices — it waterproofs the toast against the tomato.

steps.title: Season the tomato
steps.body: Slice the tomato thick and season the cut faces. Unseasoned tomato is the most common reason a BLT tastes flat.

steps.title: Stack and cut
steps.body: Bacon, then tomato, then lettuce last so it stays cold and crunchy. Close, press, and cut on the diagonal.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipes.summary: Seared chicken and crisp lettuce in a creamy, lemony, parmesan-heavy dressing, rolled up.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.body: Season the chicken well and sear over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Rest it a few minutes before slicing, or the juice ends up on the board.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.body: Stir mayonnaise with a hard squeeze of lemon, a generous amount of grated parmesan, and plenty of black pepper until it pours thickly off the spoon.

steps.title: Toss the lettuce
steps.body: Shred the lettuce and toss it with just enough dressing to coat. Dress it at the last second so it stays crisp.

steps.title: Roll
steps.body: Warm the tortillas so they bend without cracking, lay the chicken and lettuce down the middle, fold the ends in and roll tight.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwich
recipes.summary: Jammy chopped eggs bound with mustardy mayonnaise on soft bread.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.body: Nine minutes in boiling water, then straight into ice water. Nine gives you a yolk that is set but still golden rather than chalky and grey.

steps.title: Chop, don't mash
steps.body: Peel and chop the eggs roughly. Texture is the whole point — mashing turns it into paste.

steps.title: Dress it
steps.body: Fold through mayonnaise, a spoonful of mustard, and finely diced onion. Season harder than you think; eggs take a lot of salt.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Pile it thick on soft bread, close, and cut. This one is better cold, so it can wait in the fridge for an hour.

recipes.title: Turkey Avocado Wrap
recipes.summary: Cold turkey, creamy avocado and crunch, wrapped for a lunch that needs no reheating.

steps.title: Smash the avocado
steps.body: Mash the avocado directly onto the tortilla with plenty of seasoning. It doubles as the spread, so no sauce is needed.

steps.title: Layer the fillings
steps.body: Lay the turkey over the avocado, then the tomato and cucumber, and the lettuce last against the outer edge.

steps.title: Roll and rest
steps.body: Fold the sides in, roll tight, and let it sit seam-down for a minute so it holds its shape.

steps.title: Cut and go
steps.body: Slice on a steep diagonal and wrap the halves if it's travelling.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.summary: Crisp golden tortilla, molten cheddar, seasoned chicken and sweet peppers.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.body: Dice the chicken small, season it, and sear until golden. Add the bell pepper and onion and cook until soft and lightly charred.

steps.title: Layer with restraint
steps.body: Cheese on the tortilla first, then filling, then more cheese, then the second tortilla. The cheese on both faces is the glue.

steps.title: Griddle dry
steps.body: Cook in a dry pan over medium heat, pressing down, until the underside is spotted brown and crisp. Flip carefully and repeat.

steps.title: Rest before cutting
steps.body: Let it sit a minute off the heat so the cheese sets slightly, then cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Beef Bolognese Pasta
recipes.summary: A long-simmered meat sauce clinging to hot pasta under a drift of parmesan.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.body: Finely dice the onion and carrot and cook them gently until completely soft and sweet, about eight minutes. Rushing this is why quick bolognese tastes thin.

steps.title: Brown the beef hard
steps.body: Turn the heat up, add the beef, and let it sit undisturbed until it browns properly before breaking it apart. Add the garlic at the end.

steps.title: Simmer it down
steps.body: Add chopped tomato, season, and simmer on low for at least half an hour, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick and glossy rather than watery.

steps.title: Marry the pasta
steps.body: Cook the pasta just short of tender and finish it in the sauce with a splash of its water. Parmesan over the top, off the heat.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Pasta
recipes.summary: Blistered tomatoes melted into cream cheese for a pink, silky sauce in one pan.

steps.title: Blister the tomatoes
steps.body: Halve the tomatoes and cook them cut-side down over high heat until the skins char and they start to collapse. That char is the flavor.

steps.title: Add the garlic
steps.body: Lower the heat, add sliced garlic, and cook thirty seconds until fragrant. Crush the tomatoes with the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Melt in the cream cheese
steps.body: Stir in the cream cheese with a ladle of pasta water and stir until it turns into a smooth pink sauce with no lumps left.

steps.title: Toss and finish
steps.body: Add the drained pasta, toss hard until every piece is coated, and finish with parmesan and black pepper.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.summary: Garlicky lemon butter, sweet shrimp, and pasta that soaks up every drop.

steps.title: Start the pasta
steps.body: Get the pasta going in well-salted water and save a mug of the starchy water before draining — the sauce depends on it.

steps.title: Cook the shrimp fast
steps.body: Season the shrimp and sear in butter for barely a minute a side, until just pink. Pull them out immediately; overcooked shrimp is the only way to ruin this.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Add more butter and a lot of sliced garlic to the pan and cook until pale gold. Squeeze in the lemon and let it bubble.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.body: Toss the pasta and shrimp through the sauce with splashes of pasta water until it turns glossy and coats the strands. Parmesan and more lemon to finish.

recipes.title: Mushroom Spinach Pasta
recipes.summary: Deeply browned mushrooms, wilted spinach and garlic butter over hot pasta.

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.body: Cook the mushrooms in a wide, hot pan in a single layer. Don't stir for the first three minutes and don't crowd them, or they steam grey instead of browning.

steps.title: Build the garlic butter
steps.body: Add butter and sliced garlic and swirl until it foams and smells sweet. Keep it just below browning.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.body: Add the spinach in handfuls and stir until it collapses into the butter. Season now.

steps.title: Toss with pasta
steps.body: Add the drained pasta and a splash of its water, toss until glossy, and shower with parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.summary: Crisp breaded chicken under tomato sauce and melted mozzarella.

steps.title: Flatten and coat
steps.body: Butterfly the chicken and pound it to an even thickness. Set up three plates: seasoned flour, beaten egg, and bread blitzed into crumbs with grated parmesan.

steps.title: Bread it properly
steps.body: Flour, then egg, then crumb, pressing the crumbs on firmly. Let the coated cutlets rest ten minutes so the crust stays put in the pan.

steps.title: Fry until golden
steps.body: Shallow-fry over medium-high heat, three to four minutes a side, until deep gold. Drain on a rack, not paper, so the underside stays crisp.

steps.title: Sauce and melt
steps.body: Simmer chopped tomato with garlic and seasoning into a quick sauce. Spoon it over the cutlets, top with mozzarella, and grill until bubbling and blistered.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.summary: Seared steak and crisp-tender broccoli in a glossy garlic-soy glaze over rice.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Rinse and cook the rice first — everything after this happens in under ten minutes.

steps.title: Slice against the grain
steps.body: Cut the steak into thin strips across the grain. This is what makes cheap cuts tender, and no amount of cooking will fix getting it wrong.

steps.title: Sear hard and fast
steps.body: Get the pan smoking hot and sear the beef in one layer for barely a minute. Take it out while it's still pink in the middle.

steps.title: Glaze and combine
steps.body: Cook the broccoli with a splash of water until bright green, add garlic and soy sauce, then return the beef and toss until everything is lacquered. Spoon over the rice.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
recipes.summary: Sticky sweet-savory chicken over rice with steamed broccoli alongside.

steps.title: Rice first
steps.body: Get the rice on. Teriyaki moves fast at the end and you want the rice waiting, not the other way around.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.body: Cut the chicken into large pieces and sear in a hot pan until golden on both sides and cooked through.

steps.title: Reduce the glaze
steps.body: Stir soy sauce, sugar and grated garlic together, pour it into the pan, and let it bubble down. Watch it — it goes from syrup to burnt sugar in under a minute.

steps.title: Steam and build
steps.body: Steam the broccoli until bright and just tender. Slice the chicken, lay it over rice, spoon every drop of glaze on, and set the broccoli beside it.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Cold rice, hot pan, sweet shrimp and ribbons of egg. Fifteen minutes, one wok.

steps.title: Use cold rice
steps.body: Day-old refrigerated rice is not a shortcut, it's the requirement. Fresh rice steams into mush the moment it hits the pan.

steps.title: Sear the shrimp
steps.body: Cook the shrimp in a very hot pan for a minute a side until just pink, then set them aside.

steps.title: Scramble and fry
steps.body: Scramble the eggs and push them up the side. Add diced carrot and onion, then the rice, pressing it into the hot surface so it toasts.

steps.title: Season and combine
steps.body: Return the shrimp and eggs, splash in the soy sauce around the edge of the pan so it sizzles, and toss until every grain is separate and coated.

recipes.title: Pork Pepper Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Thin pork and blistered peppers in a sharp garlic-soy sauce over rice.

steps.title: Rice on
steps.body: Start the rice so it steams while you prep everything else.

steps.title: Slice thin
steps.body: Cut the pork into thin strips and the peppers and onion into wide pieces. Everything in a stir-fry should be able to cook through in about two minutes.

steps.title: Sear in batches
steps.body: Cook the pork in a screaming-hot pan in two batches. Crowding the pan drops the temperature and boils the meat instead of searing it.

steps.title: Toss it together
steps.body: Blister the peppers and onion over high heat, add the garlic for thirty seconds, then return the pork with the soy sauce and toss until glossy. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Salmon Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Flaked salmon over warm rice with cool cucumber and avocado, dressed in soy and lemon.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Get the rice going. It should still be warm when the bowl is built — the contrast against the cold vegetables is the whole idea.

steps.title: Roast the salmon
steps.body: Season the salmon and roast or pan-sear it until it flakes under gentle pressure but is still deep pink inside. Let it rest, then break it into large flakes.

steps.title: Prep the cold half
steps.body: Slice the cucumber thin and the avocado into wedges. Dress the cucumber with a little soy sauce and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Warm rice in the bowl, salmon on one side, cucumber and avocado on the other, and a final spoonful of soy and lemon over everything.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.summary: Seasoned beef in warm tortillas with cold lettuce, tomato and a fistful of cheddar.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Cook the onion until soft, then add the beef and let it brown properly before breaking it up. Season generously and cook until the edges crisp.

steps.title: Let it tighten
steps.body: Add a splash of water and simmer a few minutes until it thickens into something that holds in a tortilla rather than running out of it.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.body: Heat them one at a time in a dry pan until they puff and soften. Stack them under a towel so they stay pliable.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Beef first, then cheddar so it melts against the heat, then lettuce and tomato cold on top.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.summary: Rolled tortillas filled with shredded chicken, baked under tomato sauce and cheddar.

steps.title: Poach and shred
steps.body: Simmer the chicken in seasoned water until cooked through, then shred it with two forks. Keep a little of the cooking liquid to stop the filling drying out.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Cook the onion and garlic until soft, add chopped tomato, and simmer until thick. Blend it smooth if you want the classic texture.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.body: Mix some sauce and cheese through the chicken, spoon it down each tortilla, and roll them up seam-side down in a baking dish.

steps.title: Sauce and bake
steps.body: Pour the rest of the sauce over, cover with cheddar, and bake until bubbling and browned at the edges, about twenty minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Tacos
recipes.summary: Charred shrimp, cool avocado and crisp lettuce with a hard squeeze of lemon.

steps.title: Season the shrimp
steps.body: Pat the shrimp bone dry and season well. Wet shrimp steams; dry shrimp chars, and the char is what you're here for.

steps.title: Sear hot
steps.body: One minute a side in a very hot pan. They're done the moment they curl and turn opaque.

steps.title: Make the crema
steps.body: Stir mayonnaise with a big squeeze of lemon and plenty of pepper until it's just thin enough to drizzle.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Warm the tortillas, lay down lettuce, then shrimp, then sliced avocado, and finish with the lemon crema and one more squeeze of juice.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.summary: Fried eggs on a crisped tortilla under a warm, garlicky tomato sauce.

steps.title: Make the ranchero sauce
steps.body: Soften the onion and garlic, add chopped tomato, season, and simmer ten minutes until it thickens and darkens.

steps.title: Crisp the tortillas
steps.body: Fry each tortilla in a little oil until it stiffens and blisters. A soft tortilla under sauce turns to paste.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.body: Cook the eggs in a hot pan until the whites are set and lacy at the edges but the yolks are still liquid.

steps.title: Plate it
steps.body: Tortilla down, eggs on top, sauce spooned around rather than over so the yolks stay visible, and sliced avocado alongside.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.summary: Savory beef and vegetables under a browned blanket of buttery mashed potato.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Start the potatoes in cold salted water and bring them up to a boil. Starting in hot water cooks the outsides to mush before the centers are done.

steps.title: Build the filling
steps.body: Cook the onion and carrot until soft, then brown the beef hard. Season well and simmer with a little water until it thickens into gravy.

steps.title: Mash rich
steps.body: Drain the potatoes and let the steam escape for a minute, then mash with plenty of butter and warm milk until smooth.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.body: Spread the mash over the filling and drag a fork across it — those ridges are what catch the color. Bake until the peaks are brown and the edges bubble.

recipes.title: Classic Meatloaf
recipes.summary: A tender beef loaf under a sticky ketchup glaze, good hot tonight and cold tomorrow.

steps.title: Soak the bread
steps.body: Tear the bread and soak it in the milk until it falls apart. This is the step that keeps meatloaf tender instead of dense — don't skip it for dry breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Mix gently
steps.body: Combine the soaked bread with the beef, egg, finely diced onion and plenty of seasoning. Mix with your hands only until it comes together; overworking makes it springy.

steps.title: Shape free-form
steps.body: Form a loaf on a lined tray rather than pressing it into a tin. More surface means more browned crust.

steps.title: Glaze and bake
steps.body: Brush ketchup over the top and bake about forty-five minutes, glazing again halfway. Rest ten minutes before slicing or it falls apart.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples
recipes.summary: Golden-crusted chops with soft, buttery apples cooked down in the same pan.

steps.title: Dry and season
steps.body: Pat the pork completely dry and season it well on both sides. Moisture on the surface is the enemy of a crust.

steps.title: Sear undisturbed
steps.body: Sear in a hot pan for four minutes without touching it, then flip. Pull the chops out while they're still faintly pink and let them rest.

steps.title: Cook the apples
steps.body: Drop butter into the same pan with sliced apple and onion. Cook until they soften and catch color in the pork fat.

steps.title: Make the pan sauce
steps.body: Stir a spoonful of mustard through the apples with a splash of water, scraping up everything stuck to the pan, and spoon it over the rested chops.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak and Potatoes
recipes.summary: A rested, crusted steak basted in garlic butter, with crisp potatoes from the same pan.

steps.title: Par-boil the potatoes
steps.body: Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil until just tender. Drain and shake them in the pan so the edges rough up — that roughness is what crisps.

steps.title: Crisp them
steps.body: Fry the potatoes in a hot pan until deeply golden all over, season, and keep them warm.

steps.title: Sear the steak
steps.body: Bring the steak to room temperature, dry it, salt it hard, and sear in a smoking pan. Don't move it for three minutes.

steps.title: Baste and rest
steps.body: Add butter and crushed garlic, tilt the pan, and spoon the foaming butter over the steak for a minute. Rest it five minutes before slicing across the grain.

recipes.title: Sausage and Peppers
recipes.summary: Browned sausage tangled with sweet peppers and onion, piled onto crusty bread.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.body: Cook the sausages whole over medium heat until browned all over. Resist pricking them — the fat inside is doing the cooking.

steps.title: Soften the peppers
steps.body: Take the sausages out and cook thick-sliced peppers and onion in the rendered fat until they slump and sweeten, about ten minutes.

steps.title: Finish together
steps.body: Slice the sausages, return them to the pan with the garlic, and cook another five minutes until everything is glazed and sticky.

steps.title: Serve on bread
steps.body: Split and toast the bread, pile the sausage and peppers on, and spoon the pan juices over the top.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Broccoli
recipes.summary: A whole dinner on one tray — lemony salmon and charred broccoli, twenty-five minutes start to finish.

steps.title: Heat the tray
steps.body: Get the oven hot and put the tray in empty. Vegetables landing on a hot tray start browning immediately instead of steaming.

steps.title: Roast the broccoli first
steps.body: Toss the florets with oil, seasoning and sliced garlic, spread them out with room between, and roast ten minutes.

steps.title: Add the salmon
steps.body: Push the broccoli aside, lay the seasoned salmon in the gap with lemon slices on top, and roast another ten to twelve minutes.

steps.title: Check and finish
steps.body: The salmon is ready when it flakes under gentle pressure at the thickest point. Squeeze the roasted lemon over everything before serving.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops with Garlic and Lemon
recipes.summary: Fast-seared lamb with a garlicky crust and a sharp squeeze of lemon to cut the richness.

steps.title: Get the potatoes going
steps.body: Boil the potatoes until tender while the lamb comes up to room temperature — cold lamb straight from the fridge cooks unevenly.

steps.title: Render the fat edge
steps.body: Stand the chops fat-edge down in a hot pan first and hold them there until the fat turns golden and crisp. This renders it and greases the pan at once.

steps.title: Sear and baste
steps.body: Lay them flat and sear three minutes a side for pink in the middle. Add butter and crushed garlic and baste for the last minute.

steps.title: Rest and dress
steps.body: Rest the chops five minutes, crush the potatoes into the pan juices, and squeeze lemon over everything just before serving.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
recipes.summary: Creamy baked pasta with tuna and onion under a crisp cheddar top.

steps.title: Undercook the pasta
steps.body: Boil the pasta two minutes short of tender. It keeps cooking in the oven, and fully cooked pasta comes out of a casserole as mush.

steps.title: Make the white sauce
steps.body: Melt butter, stir in the flour and cook a minute, then add the milk slowly, whisking, until it thickens enough to coat a spoon. Season well.

steps.title: Fold it together
steps.body: Soften the onion, then fold it through the sauce with the drained tuna, half the cheddar and the pasta.

steps.title: Bake until crisp
steps.body: Tip into a dish, scatter the rest of the cheddar over, and bake until bubbling with a browned crust, about twenty minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Soup
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked tomatoes blended smooth and enriched with cream cheese.

steps.title: Sweat the aromatics
steps.body: Cook the onion in butter over low heat for a full ten minutes until completely soft and sweet, then add the garlic. This slow start is where the depth comes from.

steps.title: Simmer the tomatoes
steps.body: Add roughly chopped tomatoes and a splash of water, season, and simmer twenty minutes until everything has broken down.

steps.title: Blend and enrich
steps.body: Blend until completely smooth, then stir in the cream cheese off the heat until it melts through and the color turns from red to coral.

steps.title: Serve with toast
steps.body: Toast thick slices of bread, cut them into soldiers, and serve alongside for dipping.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato
recipes.summary: A crisp-skinned potato split open and filled with cheddar, bacon and cool yogurt.

steps.title: Prep the skin
steps.body: Scrub the potatoes, prick them all over, and rub the skins with oil and plenty of salt. Baking them directly on the rack, not in foil, is what gives a crisp skin.

steps.title: Bake long
steps.body: An hour in a hot oven. They're ready when a knife slides into the center with no resistance at all.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.body: While they bake, cook the bacon until it snaps, then chop it roughly.

steps.title: Split and load
steps.body: Cut a cross in the top, squeeze the ends to open it up, and fork butter through the fluffy inside. Then cheddar, bacon, and a spoonful of yogurt on top.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.summary: The good use for three black bananas — dense, sweet, and better on day two.

steps.title: Use overripe bananas
steps.body: The blacker the better. Mash them completely — underripe bananas give you a bland loaf no amount of sugar will fix.

steps.title: Cream and combine
steps.body: Beat the melted butter with the sugar, then the eggs one at a time, then the mashed banana.

steps.title: Fold in the flour
steps.body: Fold the flour through until it just disappears. Every extra stir builds gluten and takes the loaf a step closer to rubbery.

steps.title: Bake and wait
steps.body: Bake about an hour, until a skewer comes out clean. Cool it completely in the tin — cutting it warm tears the crumb.

recipes.title: Apple Oat Crumble
recipes.summary: Soft spiced apples under a craggy, buttery oat topping.

steps.title: Cook the apples down
steps.body: Peel and chop the apples, then cook them with a little sugar and water for five minutes until they soften at the edges but still hold their shape.

steps.title: Rub the topping
steps.body: Rub cold butter into the flour, oats and sugar with your fingertips until it clumps. Cold butter and a light touch are what give you rubble instead of paste.

steps.title: Assemble loosely
steps.body: Tip the apples into a dish and scatter the topping over without pressing it down. The gaps are what let it crisp.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.body: Bake about thirty-five minutes, until the top is deep gold and the fruit bubbles up around the edges. Rest ten minutes before serving.
